payload.body: Phases fix landed at 45acc46 (fix-forward on 9907e17, by path: arngz.lua, plan.lua, plan_test.lua, opt/arngz/arngz, arngz.bats, help/arngz.md; index checked empty; no amend). Design note: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Utilz/67bcef6b-d20d-4bb9-ac53-ff7fbaf2e422/scratchpad/design-note-phases.md (dc's refusal edge and mid-change reads in; for design.md after 0605). (a) running judgement: observe(bundles) asks applicationsForBundleID per desk app, through infoForBundleID for the app's own case (measured case-sensitive: com.apple.Finder finds nothing); a raising lookup is unread; discover/observe keep the sweep, named by apps_running_source. (b) apply in phases, one doAfter callback each, waits rescheduling themselves; arngz_running held across them, so a second apply mid-run is refused exit 2 with a fix line naming hs.reload(); phase failures after a change are op 'phase' results and apply goes to finish; every callback guarded, answered once. (c) raise before hold: win:focus, hit test polled up to 1 s, failure names the covering app; a raise that switched the desktop fails saying so; the carry message names the window's spaces against the step. Evidence: plan_test 171/171; arngz.bats 121/121 under bash 3.2.57 and 5.3.20; shellcheck 22 clean; acceptance.sh observe and diff handrun live ok; stubbed-hs phase harness 13 cases, 5 mutations each red. critic-lua: 1 critical and 4 warnings, then 0 critical and 1 warning, all fixed. Not measured here: anything that takes the pointer; that is your hands-off re-run (hold 14).
